task.title: Create recovery codes for two-factor authentication (2FA)
task.shortdesc: You can use a recovery code to authenticate and log in to your account if you lose your authenticator device or your authenticator app is not available. Create recovery codes after you enable two-factor authentication for your account.

ul.li: Enable two-factor authentication for your account.

step.cmd: Log in to your Red Hat user account on any Red Hat site, such as Red Hat Customer Portal.
Click your user avatar in the upper right corner of the page.

substep.cmd: Click Account details. A page opens where you can edit your account information.
If you log in through Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console, click My profile under your user avatar to edit your account information.

info.p: A page opens where you can review your account information.
info.note: Depending on which login portal you use, a different icon may appear.

step.cmd: Click Account details. A page opens where you can edit your account information.
On the Login & password page scroll down to 2-factor authentication and click Manage 2-factor authentication. The Signing in page opens.
The Recovery codes page opens and shows a list of unique codes.
Carefully follow the instructions on this page to print, download, or copy the list of codes.

info.note: Keep the recovery codes in a safe place. When you enable recovery codes, the next time you log in you will be asked for a recovery code.

step.cmd: Click Complete setup to return to the Signing in page.
The Signing in page verifies when you created the recovery codes and how many have been used.
